name: – § 41 – Am 12
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2024 in Baku, Azerbaijan (COP29)
part_text: 41.Recalls the importance of conducting COP conferences in an efficient and environmentally friendly manner; underlines that there is an urgent need to limit the number of participants to a few hundred people who are designated by the Parties and duly and democratically legitimised; calls for the increased use of virtual platforms at COPs;
